# Hecaton

> Hecaton is a fractional platform-engineering practice, principal-led by Jaime Baldó. It helps scaling SaaS teams with two engagements: a fixed-scope Platform Audit & Roadmap, and an ongoing Fractional Platform Engineer retainer (10–20 hours a week).

Hecaton works remotely from Spain (CET/CEST) and serves teams worldwide, comfortable working async from US East to APAC. Focus areas: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), CI/CD, observability, FinOps and cloud cost reduction, and SOC 2 readiness. Jaime does the work himself; there is no larger team yet. Hecaton takes one new retainer client at a time.

Past results (from Jaime's employed roles, not Hecaton engagements): 52% AWS bill reduction, 95% fewer outages in 3 months, SOC 2 readiness at several companies, observability across 70+ AWS accounts, 40% lower CI/CD spend.
